notes: CHANGE MY PLAN SCENARIO NOW USABLE FROM THE SCENARIOS PAGE. New template card 'Change my plan' (type revise) on the Add scenario chooser. Each row: what changes (expense categories from getExpenseCats, EMIs still running now or later, investments), a from month, and a new monthly amount; 0 stops an EMI or contribution. Under each row a live line shows the planned amount for that month and the change, e.g. 2027-01: Rs 42,405 -> Rs 55,000/mo (+Rs 12,595). That planned figure is read from runProjection(...).reviseBase, which is the engine's own reviseCtx object returned on the result, not a recomputation, so the editor shows exactly the base a revision is measured from. The line warns when a change will do nothing: category deleted, EMI not running that month, investment closed by then. Saved rows keep their target even if it is later deleted or closed (shown as deleted / closed) rather than being re-pointed. Empty rows are dropped on save; an amount of 0 is kept. Scenario list summary shows the first two changes by date. Commit to base is refused for this type with an explanation, because commit deletes the scenario afterwards and dated category changes have no home in the base plan. The editor states that the new amount is fixed and does not inflate; that is the engine's behaviour (v2026.11.11.01) and is a deliberate choice to revisit if wrong. ALSO FIXED: the x on Custom scenario income/expense event rows had no click handler and did nothing; it now removes the row. LAYOUT: row is target on line one, month and amount on line two; on narrow screens the existing CSS rule moves the amount to its own line. Measured at 390px and 1280px: no overlap, no overflow. VERIFIED in headless Chromium by driving the real UI (template card, select, month, amount, add, delete, save, reopen, preview, commit): saved params match what was entered; previewing the saved scenario gives totalExpense, netWorth and contribPerMonth identical to calling the engine directly with the same changes; Projection sheet renders the revision rows; reopen round-trips all values including 0; commit leaves the scenario in place; no page errors. Engine with no scenarios still identical to v2026.05.13.03, 27 engine assertions pass, Projection and Net Worth still open on the current month (v2026.11.11.02). Chart.js stubbed (no network on the test machine). NOT VERIFIED: the guards sheetVsDash, decisionUsesChain, instrumentCrossPageMismatch and accountDeltaMismatches are not in the HTML file and were not run. KNOWN: in the Decisions itemisation (_dcScenAt) only revisions that raise an expense appear; reductions and contribution changes are applied to the numbers but not listed. NOT BUILT: closed-EMI zero row; settlement on its own line; Edit balances port and Instruments page deletion; Decisions/Scenarios merge.
